# Hawkeye Project Copilot Instructions

Use the repository skill at `.github/skills/oss-hawkeye/SKILL.md` for proposed
dependency installs, package-safety questions, remediation, and Hawkeye workflow
status. Prefer the `@oss-hawkeye` chat participant when it is available.

Never offer a skip-audit or direct-install bypass. Preserve Hawkeye's returned
verdict, state, and next action exactly. `UNKNOWN` and `NOT_APPLICABLE` are not
approvals, and unavailable evidence must never be described as safe.
